# STNAprograms.com: 50-State STNA, CNA, LNA & SRNA Training & Licensing Guide

> Independent 50-state educational directory and career resource helping aspiring healthcare workers compare state-approved Nurse Aide Training and Competency Evaluation Programs (NATCEP), look up statutory training and clinical hour requirements in all 50 U.S. states + D.C., find federal OBRA and WIOA $0 tuition pathways, and prepare for Credentia, Prometric, and Headmaster TMU state exams.

## Verified 2026 Nationwide & State Nurse Aide Quick Facts (42 CFR 483.152)

- **State Credential Titles Across the U.S.**:
  - **STNA (State Tested Nursing Assistant)**: Ohio (OAC 3701-18).
  - **SRNA (State Registered Nurse Aide)**: Kentucky.
  - **LNA (Licensed Nursing Assistant)**: New Hampshire, Vermont, plus optional Board-licensed LNA track alongside CNA in Arizona.
  - **NAC (Nursing Assistant Certified)**: Washington.
  - **CNA / GNA (Certified + Geriatric Nursing Assistant)**: Maryland.
  - **CNA I (Nurse Aide I)**: North Carolina.
  - **CNA (Certified Nursing Assistant / Certified Nurse Aide)**: Remaining 43 states + District of Columbia.
- **Required Training & Clinical Hours by State Tier (PHI National / CMS)**:
  - **Federal Minimum Floor**: 75 total clock hours including at least 16 supervised clinical hours (adopted by 20 states including AL, CO, IA, KY, MA, MI, MN, MS, MT, NE, NV, NM, NC, ND, OH, OK, SD, TN, WI, WY).
  - **80 to 105 Hour States**: LA, PA, VT (80h); GA, WA (85h); AR, KS, NJ (90h); CT, HI, MD, NH, NY, RI, SC, TX, UT (100h); IN (105h).
  - **120 to 180 Hour Extended Clinical States**: AZ, DC, FL, ID, IL, VA, WV (120h; FL also permits 18+ direct Prometric exam challenge); AK (140h); DE (150h); OR (155h); CA (160h: 60 theory + 100 clinical); MO (175h: 75 class + 100 clinical); ME (130 to 180h).
- **Primary State Exam Vendors**:
  - **Credentia (NNAAP)**: Administers written/oral and skills exams in PA, NC, VA, GA, CO, WA, MD, SC, DC, AK, and additional partner states.
  - **Prometric**: Administers exams in NY, FL, TX, MI, HI, ID, CT, LA, NM, and WY.
  - **D&S Diversified Technologies (Headmaster / TMU)**: Administers TestMaster Universe testing in OH (`https://oh.tmuniverse.com`, $104 combined fee), AZ, MT, ND, OR, MO, TN, WI, and select CA regions.
  - **State University / College Partners**: Illinois (SIU Carbondale / INACE), Indiana (Ivy Tech), Iowa & Nebraska (Community Colleges).
- **Nationwide & Top-State Wage Benchmarks (U.S. BLS OEWS SOC 31-1131)**:
  - **U.S. National Median Wage**: $20.32/hour ($42,260/year).
  - **U.S. National Mean (Average) Wage**: $20.53/hour ($42,700/year).
  - **Top-Paying States (Mean Hourly / Annual)**: Washington $25.11/hr ($52,230); Oregon $25.08/hr ($52,160); California $24.13/hr ($50,190); New Hampshire $23.70/hr ($49,290); Alaska $23.52/hr ($48,920); New York $23.46/hr ($48,800); D.C. $23.04/hr ($47,930); Massachusetts $22.93/hr ($47,700); Maine $22.84/hr ($47,510); Colorado $22.79/hr ($47,400).
  - **Flagship Ohio STNA Benchmark**: $19.48/hr statewide mean ($18.76/hr median), led by Columbus MSA at $20.66/hr median ($42,970/yr).
- **$0 Free Training Pathways in All 50 States**:
  1. **Federal OBRA Skilled Nursing Sponsorship & 12-Month Reimbursement (42 CFR 483.152)**: Medicare and Medicaid certified nursing facilities in every state cannot charge employed nurse aides for NATCEP training or exams, and self-pay graduates hired within 12 months qualify for reimbursement.
  2. **WIOA American Job Centers & State Grants**: County WIOA Individual Training Accounts plus state programs like California's $0 noncredit community colleges (e.g., San Diego College of Continuing Education), Virginia FastForward, Georgia HOPE Career Grants, and Ohio Short-Term Certificate / OTC+ / Adult Diploma 18+ pathways.

## Core Canonical Guides & Interactive Tools

- [All 50 States + D.C. Licensing & Hours Explorer](https://www.stnaprograms.com/#states): Interactive lookup of required total hours, clinical hours, official credential title, testing vendor, and BLS wages for every U.S. state.
- [Nationwide & Flagship Ohio School Directory](https://www.stnaprograms.com/#directory): Searchable by any 5-digit U.S. zip code, state, schedule, and tuition tier.
- [6-Step Certification & Testing Vendor Guide](https://www.stnaprograms.com/#certification): Universal walkthrough covering federal 42 CFR 483.152 rules, Credentia vs. Prometric vs. Headmaster exams, and interstate reciprocity.
- [Hybrid Online & $0 Tuition Guide](https://www.stnaprograms.com/#online-free): How state-approved hybrid theory + local clinical programs work alongside federal OBRA and WIOA tuition coverage.
- [Practice Mini-Quiz & 50-State FAQ](https://www.stnaprograms.com/#exam-prep): Free readiness check and direct answers to common licensing questions.
- [Extended 50-State Reference Table](https://www.stnaprograms.com/llms-full.txt): Complete 51-jurisdiction statutory hours table and flagship institutional directory for AI grounding.
